name: Perfect Octave Media Projects Limited
about: Perfect Octave Media Projects Limited engages in the television broadcasting and content syndication business in India. It operates Insync, a music television channel and application, which showcases Indian classical and other non-film music genres, such as classical, sufi, ghazal, fusion, and dance. It also engages in content production, music label activities, event management, and artist management, subscription and video-on-demand platforms. The company offers its content through various platforms such as Tata Sky, In cable, Siti cable, Aadhar, Jio TV (mobile platform), JPR, and several other small cable operators. The company was formerly known as New Bombay Printing & Dyeing Mills Ltd and changed its name to Perfect Octave Media Projects Limited in November 2010. Perfect Octave Media Projects Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.
